doc.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Tommy Turk as the first serious hipster
summary: Quoted calling Tommy Turk the first serious hipster he met, Allison says only that he liked him a lot.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: You mentioned that being around Tommy Turk in the Army... Here’s a quote. You said: “He was the first serious hipster that I had met, and I was very conscious of being the yokel.” It seems that at that age, you’re 19, you’re in the Army, you’re on your own, and here’s this worldly guy from Pittsburgh, a great player, and it sounds like something you were starting to aspire to.
Well, I don’t know. I don’t remember... Well, I remember I liked Tommy Turk a lot.
Well, you knew that you wanted to be a musician, that that’s what you wanted to do with your life. Did that happen then?
